title: 第7章 置办第8章 毒发
content_zh:
第一件事，才买的骑了没几天的马好像不见了，第二件事，忘记第一时间给笛飞声送信了，告诉他李莲花已经找到。
马，不见了，这很正常！
笛飞声，很久不见了，送了信也没有马上赶来，这不正常！
众所周知，金鸳盟盟主最缺少的就是耐心，要不然他也不会被角大美女绑在地牢里，还要让李莲花去搭救。
方多病又转念一想，笛飞声那么大的人了，就算现在有什么问题，金鸳盟又被他重新掌握在手中，手下也都是忠心的，有什么问题也都能解决咯！
总之，现在笛飞声不重要，屋里的李莲花才重要。
先升火，下午赶紧去准备物资，没有马没关系，他用轻功去镇上，直接买一辆马车，拉一车装备回来。
顺便再看看有没有别的菜种花籽之类的，小花喜欢。
想着李莲花，手里的动作又快了几分。
“李莲花，莲花……”方多病喊了李莲花几嗓子，“火生好了！”
见屋里人没回应，他便提着生好的火炉回了房间，虽然已经过了清明，可这海边小渔村里的老房子还是又湿又冷，在屋里烧水，也可以顺便烘烘屋子。
屋里怎么这么清静，不会吧！难道李莲花又跑了？
要是真的，方多病就真的要生气了。
“小宝，小宝，你快出来看！”
“来啦！”方多病听见李莲花喊他的声音，赶紧出门，就见一匹白马跟在李莲花身后，这正是自己刚才想的那匹马。
“你去哪了？”方多病也顾不得这马是从哪跑回来的，直奔向李莲花，扯着他的衣襟，仔细打量生怕这一个不小心，这人又整出一些新伤，方多病是真怕！
“松手！松手！”李莲花皱了皱眉头，“光天化日，大庭广众的，拉拉扯扯像什么样子？！”
“还不都是你？”方多病撒了手，有些气恼“胡跑什么？现在你自己行动不方便，你不知道吗？”
“我这不是没事嘛！”李莲花掸了掸衣袖，又指着马说，“快，快把它拴好，我们家多了一匹马！”
“哼~这本来就是本少爷的马！”嘴上虽然抱怨着，手上功夫也不停，牵着马，拴在院中，刚好下午骑马去，只要买一辆车就行了。

“你干什么去了？”
“我想去村里看看有没有多余的被褥，晚上你好休息！”
“本少爷来了，你就不用操心了，好好在家待着。”方多病听说他是为了自己出门找东西去了，心里的无名火消了大半，“下午我会去镇里采买一些东西，你和狐狸精好好看家。”
想了想又补充了几句话，“要是这次本少爷回来发现你又不见了，再让本少爷找到你，就先拆了你的狐狸骨，再扒了你的狐狸皮！”
content_en:
The first thing was that the horse I had just bought and ridden for a few days seemed to be missing. The second thing was that I forgot to send a letter to Di Feisheng immediately, telling him that Li Lianhua had been found.
The horse is missing, this is normal!
The sound of the flute has been missing for a long time. Even after I sent the letter, I didn’t come right away. This is not normal!
As we all know, what the leader of the Golden Yuan Alliance lacks most is patience, otherwise he would not have been tied up in the dungeon by the horned beauty, and would have been rescued by Li Lianhua.
Fang Duobing then thought again, for someone with such a loud voice as Di Fei, even if there are any problems now, the Golden Yuan League is in his hands again, and his subordinates are all loyal, and any problems can be solved!
In short, the sound of Di Fei is not important now, but Li Lianhua in the room is important.
He started the fire first and quickly prepared supplies in the afternoon. It didn't matter if he didn't have a horse. He used Qinggong to go to the town, buy a carriage directly, and pull a cart of equipment back.
By the way, I'll check if there are any other vegetable seeds or the like. Xiaohua likes them.
Thinking of Li Lianhua, the movements in his hands became a little faster.
"Li Lianhua, Lianhua..." Fang Duobing called Li Lianhua several times, "The fire is ready!"
Seeing that there was no response from the people in the house, he returned to the room with the lit stove. Although it was already past Qingming Festival, the old house in this small fishing village by the sea was still wet and cold. He could heat the house by boiling water.
Why is the room so quiet? No way! Could it be that Li Lianhua ran away again?
If it were true, Fang Duobing would really be angry.
"Xiaobao, Xiaobao, come out and see!"
"Here we come!" Fang Duobing heard Li Lianhua calling him and hurried out, only to see a white horse following Li Lianhua. This was exactly the horse he was thinking of just now.
"Where have you been?" Fang Duobing didn't care where the horse came from. He ran straight to Li Lianhua, grabbed his lapel, and looked at him carefully for fear that if he was not careful, this man would get some new injuries. Fang Duobing was really scared!
"Let go! Let go!" Li Lianhua frowned, "What does it look like in broad daylight and in public?!"
"Isn't it all you?" Fang Duobing threw away his hand, a little annoyed, "Why are you running around? It's inconvenient for you to move around now, don't you know?"
"I'm fine!" Li Lianhua dusted her sleeves, pointed at the horse and said, "Quick, tie it up quickly, we have an extra horse in our family!"
"Hmph~ This is my young master's horse!" Although he was complaining, he was still working hard, holding the horse and tying it in the yard. He happened to be riding a horse in the afternoon, and all he had to do was buy a car.
"What have you been doing?"
"I want to go to the village to see if there are any extra bedding, so you can have a good rest at night!"
"I'm here, so you don't have to worry. Just stay at home." Fang Duobing heard that he went out to look for things for himself, and most of the unknown anger in his heart disappeared. "I will go to the town to buy some things in the afternoon, and you and the vixen will take care of the house."
After thinking for a while, he added a few words, "If this young master comes back and finds that you are missing again, and let me find you again, I will first remove your fox bones, and then peel off your fox skin!"
